name: committee
title: AI committee: economist, risk manager, CIO (GPT-4o)
description: Three GPT-4o roles read the same masked month. The economist writes the macro read, the risk manager what could go wrong, and the CIO gives an expected one-month return per fund with a confidence word. The CIO's numbers are the stated view; the three texts are the trace.
author: Farnoosh, Diwas
